verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an observability SaaS like Datadog. However, nothing in the pack documents acting on many items at once (bulk mute, bulk edit or bulk delete of monitors, logs or other resources). The API reference, MCP server and CLI items are only titles or pointers and do not describe any bulk capability, and building one from API primitives would be a developer building block that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
